claim: The one-click demo opens three sample takes and never changes the real take list.
where: landing demo action, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /?demo=1; place a sentinel in the real database, assert sample rows in the separate demo database, reset and exit, then assert the sentinel survives while demo rows are cleared

claim: Audio analysis and take data stay in the browser; recordings are not uploaded.
where: landing facts, privacy page, README, footer
sandbox: fresh demo; intercept the complete import flow, assert same-origin requests only, then assert the real take list stays empty

claim: The app does not transcribe, generate, or clone voices.
sandbox: fresh demo; exercise local analysis with all requests captured, assert no external service calls, and verify the plain boundary copy

claim: The app works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh demo; wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and assert all three sample takes remain

claim: Numbered take filenames group by dialogue line and each line remains editable.
sandbox: fresh demo; import two generated WAV files with numbered names and assert one editable two-take line group

claim: The app compares level, pace, pauses, and pitch range against an approved take as review cues.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert the approved take and four named measurements with observable differences and review-cue labels

claim: CSV export includes one row per take with review details and measurements.
sandbox: fresh demo; download CSV and assert its header plus exactly three sample rows including the flagged take

claim: Free mode supports 12 takes and CSV export.
where: landing facts, Studio details, README, terms
sandbox: enter from fresh demo, start a real empty list, import 12 generated WAVs, assert CSV stays enabled, and assert take 13 is rejected

claim: A $19 one-time Studio license adds unlimited takes and backups that include audio.
where: landing Studio section, Studio details, README, terms
sandbox: enter from fresh demo, use a recorded verified-license verdict, import 13 generated WAVs, and assert the downloaded backup contains all audio data

claim: Studio checkout and license verification use only the Sociobot billing product routes.
sandbox: enter from fresh demo; assert the production checkout URL, intercept the exact verification URL, and reject a recorded invalid token
